description: Create the single definitive, idempotent SQL script supabase/FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql that permanently resolves the PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.jobs in the schema cache' error for the jobs, job_applications, and banners tables. Root cause established during exploration: supabase/schema.sql and supabase/jobs_banners_LIKE_CAMPAIGNS.sql contain ZERO explicit GRANT statements; campaigns works only because it inherited Supabase's platform default privileges, while the newer tables missed the table-level and sequence grants that PostgREST needs to expose them to the anon/authenticated roles. The script must address EVERY known PGRST205 cause at once (missing grants, sequence grants, schema USAGE, table ownership, half-applied RLS, stale cache) so the user does not have to keep guessing. This is a self-contained SQL deliverable; no Flutter code changes are made in this feature.
steps: SECTION A (TOP) - a clearly commented 'RUN THIS FIRST AND SHARE THE RESULT' diagnostic block that reveals WHY the tables differ. Include: (1) SELECT grantee, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_name IN ('jobs','job_applications','banners','campaigns') AND grantee IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') ORDER BY table_name, grantee; (2) SELECT tablename, tableowner FROM pg_tables WHERE tablename IN ('jobs','job_applications','banners','campaigns'); (3) SELECT nspname, has_schema_privilege('anon', nspname, 'USAGE') AS anon_usage FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public';. Add a comment explaining the user should compare campaigns (works) vs jobs (fails): campaigns will show anon/authenticated grants and jobs will not.

SECTION B - THE FIX. Make it idempotent and safe to re-run. (a) GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role; (b) GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.jobs, public.job_applications, public.banners TO anon, authenticated, service_role; (c) GRANT ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role; (d) also set ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON TABLES TO anon, authenticated, service_role; and the same for SEQUENCES, so future tables created in this session inherit grants; (e) normalize ownership: ALTER TABLE public.jobs OWNER TO postgres; and the same for job_applications and banners (wrap each in a DO block or leave plain - both fine since they exist), matching the campaigns owner.

SECTION C - re-assert the campaigns-style RLS policies defensively so a prior half-applied state cannot conflict: ensure RLS is enabled on all three tables, then for EACH policy DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>; followed by CREATE POLICY ... using the exact campaigns-style inline EXISTS admin checks already present in supabase/jobs_banners_LIKE_CAMPAIGNS.sql (copy the 12 policies verbatim: 4 jobs, 4 job_applications, 4 banners). Do NOT drop/recreate the tables - the tables and data already exist; only re-assert grants, ownership, and policies.
SECTION D - end the script with: NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; and NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload config';.

SECTION E (as SQL comments at the bottom) - 3 to 4 verification queries the user can run after the fix: SELECT has_table_privilege('anon','public.jobs','SELECT'); (expect true), a re-run of the grants query from Section A to confirm jobs now matches campaigns, and a note: if PGRST205 STILL persists after this, go to Supabase Dashboard -> Settings -> API and confirm 'Exposed schemas' includes 'public', then use the Dashboard 'Restart project' button as a last resort.

Confirm the script is idempotent: uses DROP POLICY IF EXISTS before each CREATE POLICY, does not DROP/CREATE tables, and uses GRANT statements that are safe to re-run. Confirm parenthesis and dollar-quote ($$) balance.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql exists at the repo root supabase/ directory.

The file's TOP section is a diagnostic block marked to run first, containing the role_table_grants query comparing jobs/job_applications/banners against campaigns, a pg_tables ownership query, and a schema-USAGE check.
The fix section contains GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, GRANT ALL ON the three named tables, GRANT ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES, and ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES - all to anon, authenticated, service_role.
The script normalizes table ownership to postgres for all three tables.
All 12 campaigns-style RLS policies are re-asserted using DROP POLICY IF EXISTS then CREATE POLICY, and RLS is enabled on all three tables; the script does NOT drop or recreate the tables themselves.
The script ends with NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; and NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload config';.
The bottom of the file contains 3-4 verification queries as SQL comments plus the Dashboard Exposed-schemas / Restart-project fallback note.
The script is idempotent (safe to run multiple times) and has balanced parentheses and dollar-quotes.
verification: Read supabase/FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql end-to-end and confirm every acceptance criterion is present.
Run a brace/paren/dollar-quote balance check on the file (e.g. count of '(' vs ')' and even count of '$$').

grep the file to confirm presence of: 'GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public', 'GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.jobs', 'ALL SEQUENCES', 'ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES', 'OWNER TO postgres', 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS', "NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'", "NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload config'", 'role_table_grants', 'has_table_privilege'.
Confirm NO CREATE TABLE / DROP TABLE for jobs/job_applications/banners appears in the script (tables must not be recreated).
findings: Created supabase/FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql. Sections A (diagnostics: role_table_grants comparison vs campaigns, pg_tables ownership, anon schema-USAGE check), B (fix: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public; GRANT ALL ON the three named tables; GRANT ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES for TABLES and SEQUENCES; ALTER TABLE ... OWNER TO postgres x3), C (RLS enabled + 12 campaigns-style policies re-asserted verbatim via DROP POLICY IF EXISTS then CREATE POLICY - 4 jobs, 4 job_applications, 4 banners), D (NOTIFY pgrst reload schema + reload config), E (verification queries as comments + Dashboard Exposed-schemas/Restart-project fallback). Verified statically since Flutter/Dart not installed and network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (no live Supabase). Balance checks: parens 62/62 balanced; zero '$$' dollar-quotes (no functions/triggers included in this file, so none needed); zero em dashes; zero CREATE TABLE/DROP TABLE (tables not touched). Exactly 12 real CREATE POLICY and 12 DROP POLICY IF EXISTS statements (a 13th 'CREATE POLICY' grep hit is inside a comment line only). All required tokens present. Policies copied verbatim from supabase/jobs_banners_LIKE_CAMPAIGNS.sql. Did not modify any Flutter code; DBG3 passthrough in error_utils.dart left untouched.
